title: Indian Spices Names in English, Hindi and Regional Languages (With Commonly Confused Pairs)
seoTitle: Spices Names in English and Hindi, Plus 4 Regional Languages
seoDescription: Spice names in English and Hindi with Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi and Malayalam names, botanical names and look-alikes such as kalonji vs shahi jeera.
excerpt: A 27-spice table with Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi and Malayalam names and botanical names, plus clear ways to tell kalonji from shahi jeera, mace from nutmeg and ajwain from radhuni.
